meta.title: Simone Guarneri, short-term rentals and software
meta.description: I manage short-term rentals in Italy and build the software and automations that run them.

heroA: I manage short-term rentals in Italy
heroB: and build the software and automations that run them.
heroMeta: {age} years old, self-taught developer. I've been studying computer science since I was 16 and working in hospitality since 21, the year I opened my first Airbnb listing. I speak Italian and English; based in Salerno, Italy, and open to relocating.

what.title: Property management
what.body: Full management or just the piece you need, whether that's pricing, setting up and writing the listing, or a second opinion on a new property. Owners get a clear report every month.

what.title: Technology and automation
what.body: I build software and automations for my own homes and for other hosts, plugged into the channel managers they already use, so there's less manual work and fewer mistakes.

what.title: Growth and strategy
what.body: I look at new properties and markets through real rates, occupancy and costs, and if a deal doesn't work on paper, I'll say so.

workIntro: One brand I co-founded and one network I work with.
dorotea: Nine homes on the Amalfi Coast, in Salerno and in Milan. I helped Tommaso Apicella build it from scratch in 2023.
quattro: A direct-booking platform for more than 50 holiday homes, most around Salerno and Pompei, a few in Rome, Milan and Florence. Guests book straight with the owner, while Quattro handles 20+ booking channels, pricing and calendars for a 4% fee. I work with them on back-office and management.
buildIntro: Software I write alongside the rentals; it runs in my own homes every day before it goes anywhere else.

build.title: Casabase
build.body: Sits on top of the channel manager and covers what it doesn't do. Dorotea Housing runs on it every day.

build.title: Casadata
build.body: Drop a pin anywhere in Italy: Casadata pulls the Airbnb and Booking.com listings around it, throws out the ones that would skew the numbers and merges the rest into one report, from revenue and seasonality to competitors and comps.

build.title: AI tools
build.body: Claude Code skills and AI tools for short-term rentals: market research, listing writing and pricing analysis.

skillsIntro: What I use every day, across homes and code.

ai.label: AI
ai.note: I use it to work faster. The decisions stay mine: I review every line and answer for what ships.

how.title: Numbers first
how.body: Every decision starts from the data, and opinions come after.

how.title: Build what is missing
how.body: If the tool doesn't exist or doesn't fit, I write it.

how.title: Say it plainly
how.body: Owners hear the bad news as early as the good.

how.title: Grow when ready
how.body: A new property comes on only when the operation can carry it.

contactBody: Own a property, have a project, or want to work together? Write to me directly; I read every message myself.
